title.narrative: New Masculinity and Gender Program in Bolivia through ADH
Ny Maskulinitetsprogram i Bolivia genom ADH

description.narrative:
The general objective of the Project is:
Contribute to the construction of a democratic, inclusive and equitable culture committed to the full exercise of the human rights of women and LGBTI populations in Bolivian society, through processes of awareness, information, social articulation and knowledge management from the different approaches of masculinities, gender and human rights.
Specific objetive is:
Institutions defending human rights, women's organizations, social organizations, masculinities movements and national networks contribute, exchange and implement work methodologies with men to reduce gender violence and machismos for the construction of more inclusive and democratic societies.
.

Insatsen syftar till att anpassa och genomföra Maskulinitet program för att förebygga våld mot kvinnor i Bolivia. Resultaten kommer att användas för att utveckla program- och policyrekommendationer för att bättre engagera män och pojkar för att uppnå kvinnors fulla ekonomiska, sociala och politiska jämlikhet och för att bidrag till att förebygga våld mot kvinnor. För att omvandla genomgripande könsskillnader i Bolivia är det nödvändigt att utveckla djupare forskning och förståelse för mäns attityder och övertygelser, liksom normer och beteenden, när det gäller jämställdhet. Vidare syftar projektet till att stärka lokala partners kapacitet för att genomföra ett effektivt arbete med män för jämställdhet. Programmet kommer att genomföras i tre regioner i Bolivia och utveckla kapacitetsbyggande tillsammans med metodutveckling och nätverks uppbyggande.
Acción por los Derechos Humanos är en känd Boliviansk organisation med många års erfarenhet av forskning om maskulinitet i Bolivia.
Insatsen bedöms bidra till hållbarhetsmål 5 Jämställdhet samt Bolivias Patriotiska Agenda. Vidare bedöms insatsen bidra till strategin för Sveriges utvecklingssamarbete med Bolivia 2021–2025.

The initiative aims to adapt, and perform the masculinity approach in Bolivia. The projects aims also engage men and boys to achieve women's full economic, social and political equality and to contribute to the prevention of violence against women. In order to transform radical gender differences in Bolivia, it is necessary to develop deeper research and understanding of men's attitudes and beliefs, as well as norms and behaviors in terms of gender equality. Furthermore, the project aims at strengthening local partners capacity to carry out effective work with men for gender equality. The program will be implemented in three regions in Bolivia implementing capacity building along with method development and networking.
Acción por los Derechos Humanos is a renowned Nacional organization with many years of experience in research on masculinity.
The effort is expected to contribute to sustainability goals 5 Equality and Bolivia's Patriotic Agenda. Furthermore, the initiative is considered to contribute to the strategy for Sweden's development cooperation with Bolivia 2021-2025,

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

title.narrative: Agreement Accion por los Derechos Humanos

description.narrative:
Results 2025 In 2025, four public policy proposals with a masculinities approach were developed for one departmental government and five municipalities (La Paz,
Tarija, Huarina, Curahuara de Carangas, and El Alto). In addition, a national proposal led by youth was formulated for the Plurinational Policy of the Decade of Depatriarchalization.
Outcome 1: Capacitybuilding activities were implemented using the Sentipensante 2 (10) Masculinities Coaching model, combining popular education methods with coaching tools and NLP techniques to support behavioral change. In 2025, 400 police officers in La Paz, El Alto and Santa Cruz were sensitized, along with personnel from FELCV, DNI and the Prosecutors Office. A commitment was established to advance institutional capacitytransfer processes.
Outcome 2: Knowledge generation continued through the production of materials and participation in dialogue spaces on violence against women. Research findings were incorporated into communication products to strengthen messaging on the social impacts of hegemonic masculinities.
Outcome 3: Strategic articulation advanced through the consolidation of departmental alliances in La Paz, Tarija and Santa Cruz, and continued cooperation with youth collectives. Contributions were made to the Departmental Youth Law, which now includes a chapter on Sentipensante Masculinities and is under legislative and executive review.
Outcome 4: The communication strategy reached more than 40,000 people through 140 digital products (videos, flyers, podcasts, images). All materials adhered to Embassy of Sweden visibility guidelines and aimed to influence public discourse by promoting accountability of men in relation to genderbased violence.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
